'''July 2001 Levittown tournament (21 July)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Tri-County, Levittown, NY on 21 July 2001. [[Matt Ehrhart]] won it. It is known from Wayne Cullen's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2673">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-21-levittown-new-york-7-21-01d2673/ levittown-new-york-7-21-01], DeckTech (Wayne "Rebel Scum" Cullen, 21 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-21-levittown-new-york-7-21-01d2673/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 21 July 2001
* '''Site:''' Tri-County, Levittown, NY
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Players:''' 17
* '''Winner:''' [[Matt Ehrhart]]

== Discrepancies ==

Where a source disagrees with the record on this page, the page keeps the record and notes the difference here.

* Chris Wodicka's report gives Matt Ehrhart's winning total as 8 (+142); Ehrhart's own report gives 8 (+147).<ref name="tr-d2684" />
